pipeline.aux_rate_rule: program rate at 25 fps; half program rate at 60 fps
pipeline.hdr_422_native_input: v210 uploaded and unpacked on CUDA; L4 HEVC decodes in these tests are 4:2:0

methodology.scope: Short observations of this synthetic demo, not a long-soak capacity guarantee.
methodology.gpu_statistics: Whole GPU, sampled about every two seconds; min/mean/p95/max are within each capture.
methodology.cpu_statistics: Process group contains mixer and web backend; 100 percent equals one core. Host busy includes browser and other processes.
methodology.progress: Queue frame-count deltas divided by their measured interval, not the nominal test duration. Browser fresh-frame progress is not captured by these edge counters.
methodology.cut_latency: Encoder-output timestamps, deduplicated by kind/id/encoded_pts over all samples and final state; events already present before the capture are excluded. Small event counts limit percentile interpretation.
methodology.cut_coverage: Counts successful API cut requests separately from sampled encoder latency events. A successful request does not itself establish the visible cut latency.
methodology.percentile: Sorted values at min(n-1, int(n*0.95)); no pooling of percentiles from separate runs.
methodology.counters: Sum of compositor counter deltas across program slots and AUX outputs, also separated by group. Input repeats/discards are separate from missed deadlines and output drops. ForceFPS can repeat frames to sustain encoded FPS after output drops; target FPS alone does not pass the gate.
methodology.restart_timings: Observed setup polling phases, approximately two-second resolution. Asset preparation precedes mixer stop; restart_to_ready is the restart interval, not measured viewer blackout.
methodology.status: zero_miss_observation also requires non-stalled captured edges, expected topology and rates within tolerance. A successful start or a separate passing run does not erase an earlier failure.

startup_failures.limitation: No completed runtime capture; decoder and encoder rates, deadline counters and cut latency are not qualified.

recovery.observed_error: CUDA compositor allocation failed with out of memory while restarting the previous balanced show
recovery.limitation: The earlier successful steady and cut captures did not qualify startup or rollback allocation headroom.

startup_failures.limitation: No completed runtime capture; neither this source mix nor 256-scene operation was validated by this failed start.

recovery.failure_callback: Graph shutdown started immediately after the first encoder out-of-memory error.
recovery.native_shutdown: Shutdown blocked; the parent continued waiting for its startup deadline.
